name: webcat
description: Terminal-native AI swarm for authorized web application security assessment

scripts.clean: find apps packages -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find apps packages -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/*/dist/*.test.js apps/*/dist/*.test.js
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node apps/webcat/dist/main.js --version && node apps/webcat/dist/main.js help
